name: switch_mode_passive
reason: runtime.mode passive stopped SessionStart reinjection and left recording and retrieval working
detail: with the switch: SessionStart(compact) carried no injected span (additionalContext=""), recall ok=true count=1 found=true, 4 file(s) under objects+index, all six hooks exit 0 with parseable stdout, `status --json` reports snapshot.mode=degraded-passive. Without it, on the same project after a daemon restart: 621 byte(s) carrying an injected span, recall ok=true count=1. NOTE for the reader: passive is not a recording switch — Mode.MayRecord (internal/contract/mode.go) is false only for `off`, so the objects and index above are the design, not a leak. Not duplicated here: internal/ipc's StateFromConfig unit tests and internal/contract's monitor tests pin the mode mapping itself
control: defaults injected a checkpoint span, 621 byte(s) of additionalContext; recall ok=true count=1
